name: phr-foundry
description: PeoplesHR internal Claude Code marketplace. Distributes organization standards and tooling to engineering teams.

plugins.name: org-standards
plugins.description: PeoplesHR organization standards. Ships the phx-product-context skill for grounding answers about PeoplesHR module behaviour in the product documentation held in WeKnora, and the weknora MCP server for read-only retrieval from the PeoplesHR knowledge bases. The hands-on build skills live in the dev-kit plugin; the SQL standards review and phx-dbexplorer live in the dba-kit plugin.

plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: PeoplesHR developer build tooling. Ships the hrm-deployment-script skill for reformatting SQL to PHR conventions in .NET Framework projects, the hrm-notification skill for building a Job Scheduler email notification for any module, and the phx-debugger skill for fixing an Azure DevOps bug end to end from its bug ID. No MCP servers of its own; safe to install alongside org-standards, dba-kit or ba-kit. Install dba-kit for the phx-dbexplorer MCP server if you want schema browsing.

plugins.name: ba-kit
plugins.description: PeoplesHR product knowledge for Business Analysts. Automatically retrieves module behaviour, user flows and product documentation from WeKnora when working on requirements, solutions or client questions.

plugins.name: dba-kit
plugins.description: PeoplesHR database tooling for DBAs. Ships the phx-sql-standards-review skill for reviewing T-SQL against the OLD hSenid HRM or NEW PeoplesHR PHR-X SQL standards, and the phx-dbexplorer MCP server for browsing a SQL Server or Postgres schema. Both moved here from org-standards in its 4.0.0 release; safe to install alongside any other phr-foundry plugin.
